sources.snippet: We present our new DeepSeek-TNG R1T2 Chimera 671B model, the first successor to our original DeepSeek R1T Chimera that was released on April 26th. Unlike the original Chimera, which was based on the two parent models V3-0324 and R1, the new Chimera is a Tri-Mind with three parents, namely additionally R1-0528.
